selection_reasoning: The scene will feature multiple crafting tables spread around, but only one has a birch button attached to it. The player must first locate the birch button to identify the correct crafting table, then mine that crafting table. This creates a natural observation-then-action dependency: the birch button serves as the visual marker that tells the player which crafting table is the target. Without finding the birch button first, the player wouldn't know which crafting table to mine.

edges.reason: The birch button is attached to the target crafting table; finding the button identifies which crafting table to mine among multiple decoys

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The birch button is at spawn-relative position (-6, 0, 5), attached to the south face of the crafting table at (-6, 0, 4). The player must navigate close enough to see the button and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the button.

Uses inventory_has because mining a crafting table drops the crafting_table item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no crafting table in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms they mined one. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because the item reliably ends up in inventory.

scene_description: A grass platform with 4 crafting tables scattered around. One crafting table at ~-6,0,4 has a birch button attached to its south face (placed at ~-6,0,5). The player must explore to find the birch button, which identifies the target crafting table, then mine that crafting table. Oak logs, a barrel, and oak planks serve as visual distractors.
task_text: Find the birch button in the scene, then mine the crafting table that the birch button is attached to.
design_notes: The birch button at ~-6,0,5 uses face=wall,facing=south which means it is visually attached to the south face of the crafting table at ~-6,0,4. The player must find this button (Task 1), then mine the crafting table it's attached to (Task 2). Three other crafting tables serve as decoys. The scene is compact (~16x16 blocks) and all objects are at ground level on a flat grass platform.
